description: Approve or decline a pending OpenVibe.Actor approval for its person (plan 2026-10-28 §3.10): POST /api/v1/approvals/:id/decide { decision: approve | decline } with a service token and X-OV-Subject naming the approval's owner, the same decision the person makes on /me/approvals. Granted to OpenVibe.Network, which acts from the Action Center for the signed-in person.
